reason: This passage from Exodus (chapters 8-11) describes the plagues of Egypt and focuses exclusively on the dialogue between Moses and Pharaoh, along with God's instructions to Moses and the execution of the plagues. While the text references the Hebrew people (בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל - 'children of Israel') multiple times, it contains no instances of the Hebrew people voicing complaints about their leaders.
